newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka '96 budget deficit at prov 7.8 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka '96 budget deficit at prov 7.8 pct of GDP.

text.p: Sri Lanka's 1996 budget deficit after grants was contained at a provisional 7.8 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) against 8.3 percent in 1995, the Central Bank said in its annual report released on Wednesday.

"Despite the increase in (defence spending), an escalation in the cost of subsidies and a shortfall in privatisation proceeds, the overall budget deficit was contained at 7.8 percent of GDP," said the report, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.
